descriptions:
XBolt ANC Bluetooth Headphones Lightweight Design 

The XBolt Headphones deliver clear audio quality with active noise cancellation for a better listening experience. It uses a stable Bluetooth connection for wireless convenience and smooth connectivity. Made with lightweight materials, it provides comfortable long-term use for music, gaming, and calls.

XBolt Power Bank 20000mAh 65W Fast Charging 

The XBolt Power Bank features a 20000mAh battery capacity that provides reliable power for phones, tablets, and other devices. It supports 65W bidirectional fast charging for quicker charging and efficient power delivery. Its compact and portable design makes it suitable for travel, work, and everyday use.
